name: Unerring Stockbed
description: Seat two stocks at the same height in paired stands and match their level with one plumb line.

name: Buoying Bowarms
description: Wind the paired engines to the same count with two voices answering, each ending a half beat apart.

name: Equipoise Windlassdrum
description: Arrange the bolts between both engines in alternating weights so either crew can reach the right shaft.

name: Stakewrath
description: Aim the second engine as a mirror of the first across the mark, so the bolts strike from either side.

name: Streakhavoc
description: Loose the second engine on the sound of the first, the bolts landing a heartbeat apart on one target.

name: Ghosting Stakedrive
description: Trade aimers between the stocks mid-exchange, each stepping into the other's sight line without a pause.

name: Clawhavoc
description: Drive the second bolt into the hole the first has made in a shield or plank, tearing it through.

name: Sliderwrath
description: Throw two bolts joined by a short iron chain across the gap, the chain sweeping men from their feet.

name: Unsparing Springarm
description: Both crews gather at full wind through a long matched hold, then loose together so the bolts strike as one blow.

name: Facet Bolthead
description: Crouch on the balls of the feet with the back flat and the eye at the stock, still as a perched hawk.

name: Beneficent Aimframe
description: Read the angle and colour of the sky's light to judge which way the glare will fall on the mark.

name: Resurgent Windlassdrum
description: Count three long breaths, the third held, in the hawk's rhythm before the dive.

name: Vital Trackbed
description: Trim the fletching of each bolt to a hawk-feather curve that steadies it in a long dive.

name: Hoarfrost Boltflight
description: Lift the nose sharply and loose so that the bolt climbs and then comes down steeply.

name: Hoarfrost Skewerbolt
description: Loose a barbed bolt through a rider's saddle skirt to pin him to the beast.

name: Impalement Devastation
description: Loose with the sun at the back so that the bolt flies out of the glare, unseen until it strikes.

name: Glintstake
description: Lift and drop the stock on the one chief in the ranks, the bolt falling out of the sky onto him.

name: Mayhem Bolthead
description: Fit a whistling vane to the bolt so that its shriek in flight breaks the nerve of men beneath.

name: Rumble Boltflight
description: Hold the nose high through a long still gather of qi, then loose a bolt that comes down like a falling hawk.

name: Vital Sinewcord
description: Ram an earthen bed level beside the water for the carriage to stand on without sinking.

name: Clear Aimframe
description: Pace the basin floor from the engine to each known landmark and record the counts on a slate.

name: Verity Stockbed
description: Listen to the stream below the engine to catch the splash of boats beyond the sight line.

name: Hoarfrost Bowarms
description: Chain the engine's trail to a mooring post so a flood surge cannot drag it.

name: Radiant Springarm
description: Rotate the skein oil with each rain, replacing the damp-soaked layer before it rots.

name: Hourslider
description: Loose bolts steadily along the wharf boards until the loading gangs run from the quay.

name: Ironclaw
description: Drive a heavy bolt down through the thwarts of a crowded rowboat in a single shot.

name: Facet Skewerbolt
description: Throw a bolt with a bladed head across a river chain, parting links so the boom swings free.

name: Hurtlewrath
description: Loose steadily at the far end of a bridge to hold back the column waiting to cross.

name: Wrathful Stakedrive
description: Gather qi through a long hold, then drive a heavy bolt into the base of a wooden pier.

name: Corroding Trackbed Reckoning
description: Mass the battery's gathered force on a ford crowded with men and loose all at once, turning it into a killing ground.

name: Vigilant Springarm
description: Wax both rails of the dual track so the slider runs smoothly under a heavy shaft.

name: Remnant Stockbed
description: Count the slider's return along its track and listen for the click that says it is home.

name: Vital Bowarms
description: Weigh the head against the shaft and trim until the two balance on a single finger.

name: Punishing Impalement
description: Release the slider along its dual track so the heavy bolt starts straight and does not rock.

name: Streakglare
description: Shift the stock from the long track to the short in a stride, changing the line without unloading.

name: Vital Bolthead
description: Alternate a light bolt and a heavy one on the paired tracks, matching the winding to each in turn.

name: Hurtleruin
description: Strike the join of a plate harness with a heavy qi-driven head and part the armour.

name: Rumble Sinewcord
description: Drive a blunt-headed bolt down the track at a gate leaf or a shield wall to stagger its defenders.

name: Glint Trackbed
description: Gather the whole engine's tension through a long hold, then release one heavy bolt along both tracks as a single blow.

name: Exact Windlassdrum
description: Post each paired engine on the line by a chalk mark and give it a named station.

name: Chime Aimframe
description: Raise coloured flags from each pair to report that they are wound, loaded or loosed.

name: Springarm Vitality
description: Pass the battery commander's whistle call down the line from pair to pair without a break.

name: Energizing Windlassdrum
description: Store spare skeins in matched lengths, ready to be fitted to either engine of a pair.

name: Clairvoyant Bolthead
description: Stand down one pair at a time to rest and re-oil, never leaving the line bare.

name: Grievous Skewerbolt
description: Loose the pairs in turn down the battery line, so that the front is never free from falling bolts.

name: Glint Impalement
description: Two pairs aim from opposite ends of the line to cross their bolts over the centre of the mark.

name: Evergreen Stockbed
description: Rotate a shield screen from one pair to the next as they loose, covering each aimer in turn.

name: Clawblink
description: Bring the reserve pair up at a run into a fallen pair's station, taking up their fire.

name: Shadestake
description: Loose every pair along the battery in a rapid rolling order so the bolts dive like a stooping flock.

name: Streakscourge
description: Hold the whole battery at full wind while qi gathers through the commander's count, then release pair after pair in order.

name: Glintslider
description: Aim all pairs at a single mark, gather through a long matched hold, and loose them as one overlapping blow.

name: Daybreak Sinewcord
description: Wind two skeins to a matched tension by the pitch of each, the left and right sounding the same note.

name: Intent Trackbed
description: Seat the stance with the dantian full and qi circulating down through the legs into the carriage.

name: Elevating Bowarms
description: Read the heat in each skein through the palm, telling a tired skein from a sound one.

name: Galvanizing Aimframe
description: Swap a failing skein for its matched spare in the dark, without losing the winding.

name: Glinthurtle
description: Fill both skeins with qi evenly and release, the bolt leaving as though thrown by a stronger engine.

name: Unrelenting Bowarms
description: Hold the engine at the verge of release while attackers close, the arms trembling but still obedient.

name: Toxinstreak
description: Strike the taut skein with a finger to ring a deep note that makes nearby horses shy and men flinch.

name: Nova Boltflight
description: Overdraw both skeins by a half turn with qi packed into the sinew, risking the arms for a deeper strike.

name: Glint Stakedrive
description: Feed the skeins steadily from the dantian during a long wind, so that the release carries the whole body's strength.

name: Clawscourge
description: Hold both skeins at the limit while the qi settles, then release so the bolt drives through three ranks of men.

name: Charter Aimframe
description: Keep the knees soft and the hips low so the engine's aim does not leave the mark in a swell.

name: Verity Bolthead
description: Wipe salt spray from the sight pins with a thumb between each swell.

name: Exact Stockbed
description: Chalk a bearing mark on the rail so the stock swings back to the line each time.

name: Stakedrive Ruin
description: Hold the loose until the hull crests and the enemy hull rises to meet the line.

name: Thorn Impalement
description: Loose a barbed bolt with trailing line into a boarding party's net, pinning it to the rail.

name: Eviscerating Skewerbolt
description: Aim ahead of a running ship's bow by the length of its wake so that the bolt meets the hull.

name: Boltflight Scourge
description: Drive a heavy bolt low into the enemy planking at the waterline as the ships roll apart.

name: Sliderhavoc
description: Loose a chain-headed bolt at an enemy rudder, snapping the tiller ropes so that the ship cannot steer.

name: Nova Windlassdrum
description: Hold the line against the sea's heave, gather qi through the wind oath, and loose one bolt into the hull's heart.

name: Illuminating Springarm
description: Read the flow of the wind from the way the plateau grass lies down in waves.

name: Keen Sinewcord
description: Line the stock with two cairns set a sworn distance apart to fix a bearing.

name: Granite Trackbed
description: Chock the wheels on bare rock with flat stones, so the engine does not creep in the wind.

name: Thorn Bolthead
description: Pile stones on the carriage tail to steady the engine against a wind that tries to tip it.

name: Healing Stockbed
description: Wait without moving through a gust, hands on the stock, until the lull comes.

name: Stakeruin
description: Level the stock and loose a bolt that skims low over open plateau at the legs of a charge.

name: Impalement Ruin
description: Lean the aim into the gale by the bearing's width and loose as the wind eases.

name: Brutalizing Stakedrive
description: Send a loud bolt into a tethered horse line to stampede the mounts across the plateau.

name: Devastating Boltflight
description: Hold the aim on a single sworn mark through many breaths, then release when the wind falls.

name: Chime Skewerbolt
description: Time the bolt to ride a steady tailwind across the plateau, adding the wind's push to the arms' throw.

name: Iron Trackbed
description: Gather qi through the sworn stillness of a long aim, then loose one bolt that holds its bearing through any gale.

name: Equipoise Bowarms
description: Lay flat timbers under the wheels so the engine skids rather than digs in on dry turf.

name: Chime Sinewcord
description: Plant a tall pole at the front and sight along it to hold a bearing across the plain.

name: Chime Windlassdrum
description: Watch dust devils on the plain to read the wind at height and the likely drift.

name: Revitalizing Aimframe
description: Space the crew widely about the engine on open ground so one bolt cannot strike two.

name: Stakescourge
description: Skim the bolt a hand's height above the turf so it strikes the legs of foot and horse alike.

name: Streakruin
description: Walk the aim across the front of a moving line by small steps of the stock.

name: Might Impalement
description: Swing the carriage around its axle by a half turn to meet a flank thrust from the side.

name: Gust Boltflight
description: Keep the bearing steady while a cavalry charge comes in and loose at the last length.

name: Sliderscourge
description: Loose steadily across the plain, each bolt falling a stride beyond the last to reap the field.

name: Pitiless Sinewcord
description: Hold one bearing on open ground while qi gathers, then loose a bolt that carries through the whole line.

name: Springarm Respite
description: Rest the cheek on the stock and breathe low so the long wind does not shake the sight.

name: Thorn Claw
description: Step to the leeward side of the engine and shelter the hands before the long wait.

name: Remnant Windlassdrum
description: Read a row of cloth streamers set along the range to see the wind at every stage of the bolt's flight.

name: Might Stockbed
description: Nudge the rear pin by a hair along its scale to give for the measured wind.

name: Chime Bowarms
description: Count the bolt's flight in breaths to learn the long throw's timing.

name: Hurtlehavoc
description: Loose with the nose raised into a rising wind so that the bolt is carried further than still air allows.

name: Blaze Stakedrive
description: Hold the shot until the wind drops, then loose at a lower angle to keep the bolt from floating.

name: Clawwrath
description: Throw the bolt in an arc that curves back across a hard crosswind to land on its mark.

name: Sliderruin
description: Release with the wind at the back so the heavy head strikes with the gust's added push.

name: Hurtlescourge
description: Use the whole length of the plateau wind to throw a bolt to the farthest mark the engine can reach.

name: Stakehavoc
description: Read the streamers for each bolt in a volley and re-aim between bolts so that all land together.

name: Gnashing Skewerbolt
description: Aim a heavy bolt low along a gale so that it cuts through the wind and strikes with little drift.

name: Merciless Facet Hurtle
description: Gather qi through a long hold, then loose a bolt into a rising gale so the wind carries it far.

name: Charter Sinewcord
description: Double every lashing on the engine at the first sign of a storm.

name: Intent Aimframe
description: Wrap the winch bar with dry cord so that wet hands do not slip.

name: Waning Springarm
description: Call the pauses between gusts aloud so the crew times each pull to them.

name: Meteoric Trackbed
description: Run the engine along a pitching deck on its slide to a clear arc.

name: Chime Impalement
description: Aim at the sound of an enemy ship's bell through the rain and loose a bolt along that bearing.

name: Decimating Hurtle
description: Loose just as a wave breaks over the enemy bow, when the men there crouch.

name: Streakwrath
description: Take the aim by the flash of lightning and loose before the dark returns, the bearing held in memory.

name: Hoarfrost Bolthead
description: Hold the engine and the crew steady in the squall by swearing the wind-oath aloud together.

name: Glint Streak
description: Hold the engine through the worst of the storm, gather qi, and loose one bolt into the hull as the lightning flashes.

name: Prescient Bolthead
description: Wrap the skeins against the cold edge wind so that frost does not stiffen the sinew.

name: Aimframe Vitality
description: Circulate qi in the legs to hold the stance against a cliff wind that tugs at the carriage.

name: Galvanizing Claw
description: Feel the updraft along the cliff face on the cheek and judge how far it will lift a falling bolt.

name: Iron Stockbed
description: Hitch the engine's trail to a rock anchor so that the recoil cannot pull it over the edge.

name: Blaze Boltflight
description: Tilt the stock steeply down the cliff and loose, the bolt falling faster as it descends.

name: Maiming Stakedrive
description: Drive a bolt into the stone of a narrow ledge path, splintering the way ahead and closing it.

name: Clawruin
description: Cut a climber's rope at the cliff top with a sharp-headed bolt, dropping the whole team.

name: Blistering Skewerbolt
description: Overdraw the edge skeins with qi packed in the sinew, loosing a bolt that drives deep into the cliff face.

name: Chimeslider
description: Hold the bearing over the drop through wind and vertigo, correcting each breath, then loose when the line is true.

name: Novastake
description: Hold the skeins at their limit on the cliff lip while qi settles, then release the bolt along a single sworn bearing.
